summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Paramount International (Codeio clone). Tested home sections, theme toggle with persistence, cursor picker with all 6 modes, navigation, service/project/blog detail pages (all slugs), FAQ accordions, testimonials carousel, contact form, mobile menu, scroll reveal, and footer. 105/112 initial assertions passed. The 7 initial 'failures' were all test-selector false positives (data-testid=faq-content-N always rendered in DOM regardless of open state; project-problems/results use nested wrappers so '> *' undercounts). Re-verified via aria-expanded states and semantic selectors - all functionality works correctly.

issues: Logo renders as two separate <span> elements ('Paramount' and 'International') without a text-node space between them. Visually correct due to inline spacing but element.textContent returns 'ParamountInternational' (concatenated). Minor cosmetic/accessibility nit - consider adding a space or using a single element for screen reader clarity.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Add a text-node space between the 'Paramount' and 'International' spans in Logo component so textContent reads 'Paramount International' for assistive tech / tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Accordion.jsx renders data-testid=content-N for every item regardless of open/closed state (visibility is controlled by grid-rows class). Behaviorally correct, but data-testid presence does not reflect open state, which can confuse tests. Consider toggling the attribute based on open state, or using aria-expanded on the trigger for test assertions.
No console errors or React warnings observed during full navigation across home, 3 service pages, 3 project pages, 3 blog pages, 404, and mobile view.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified. Note that Accordion component always renders data-testid=content-N; use aria-expanded on trigger buttons or the grid-rows class to assert open/closed state in tests. Project detail nested structure: [data-testid=project-problems] contains h3 + wrapper div with h4 items (count via querySelectorAll('h4')). [data-testid=project-results] contains h3 + grid wrapper with .group items. Preview URL: https://codeio-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Default theme follows system (Playwright default = light).

Cursor picker: all 6 modes work; ring/trail/sparkle/blob/spotlight render correct elements; trail has exactly 16 spans; sparkle spawns .cur-spark on mouse move; none clears html.custom-cursor class; persists in 'pi-cursor'; Escape closes panel
Cursor ring hover state: data-state='link' on nav link hover
Navigation: all 6 nav hrefs correct, header-cta -> /#contact
Service details: all 4 slugs load; breadcrumbs, 6 features, 3 benefits, sidebar with 4 categories, cta-box, FAQ accordion toggles correctly (one open at a time, click same closes)
Project details: all 3 slugs load; 3 problems, 4 results, meta list, back-to-projects button present
Blog details: all 3 slugs load; post-meta, content, tags, share buttons (no nav), recent-posts sidebar
404: unknown routes and unknown slugs render not-found-page with working back-home
Home FAQ: default item 0 open, click trigger-2 closes 0 and opens 2, click again closes 2 (verified via aria-expanded)
Contact form: empty submit -> 'Please fill in' toast; filled submit -> 'Request sent!' toast and clears inputs
Mobile 390x844: no horizontal scroll, hamburger opens menu, mobile-nav-services closes menu and scrolls to #services
Footer: contains 'Paramount International'; Services column has 4 /services/<slug> links; Projects column has 3 /projects/<slug> links
